transcript: I was discussing the Sunday picnic with my sister If the weather is good, we will spend the day in a meadow by the river If it rains, we will watch a movie at home Unless it rains, we will leave the house at 10 in the morning We thought about several conditions and made a clear plan Tomorrow morning, unless the forecast turns much worse We will go as planned If it does rain, however, we will shift the picnic to the afternoon Whenever the forecast improves, our spirits rise with it Mother was tired, but she said she would prepare sandwiches The sight of sandwiches filling an entire basket is always a pleasant one As Sunday approaches, my sister's face remains calm The fact that everything would depend on the weather Brought our family quietly together

segments.text: I was discussing the Sunday picnic with my sister
If the weather is good, we will spend the day in a meadow by the river
If it rains, we will watch a movie at home
Unless it rains, we will leave the house at 10 in the morning
We thought about several conditions and made a clear plan
Tomorrow morning, unless the forecast turns much worse
If it does rain, however, we will shift the picnic to the afternoon
Whenever the forecast improves, our spirits rise with it
Mother was tired, but she said she would prepare sandwiches
The sight of sandwiches filling an entire basket is always a pleasant one
As Sunday approaches, my sister's face remains calm
The fact that everything would depend on the weather
